By way of this petition, Fir No.11 of 2017, dated 23.01.2017, under Sections 498A,

quashed.

sentences.text: Petitioner No.1 agreed to pay Rs.10,00,000/- to respondent No.4 as permanent alimony and settlement of all her claims.

The terms of compromise were implemented and all other litigations were brought to an end except criminal proceedings arising out of FIR No. 11 of 2017 dated 23.01.2017, registered at Police Station Amb, District Una, H.P.

entities.text: Police Station Amb, District Una, H.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The instant petition is also stated to have been filed in pursuance to the terms of the compromise arrived at between the parties.

The compromise deed has been placed on record as Annexure P-4.
3.
Respondent No.4 and petitioner No.1 are present in Court today.
Their separate statements have been recorded.
Both of them have verified the contents of the petition as well as of compromise Annexure P-4 as correct.

Respondent No.4 has specifically stated that she has received the entire ...3...
amount as promised to be paid to her by petitioner No.1.

All .
other litigations inter se the parties have come to an end.

In view of the compromise, respondent No.4 has no objection in case FIR No. 11 of 2017 dated 23.01.2017 registered at Police Station Amb,
District Una, H.P. and criminal proceedings arising therefrom are ordered to be quashed.
4.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.4 have shown their intent to bring to an end all litigations with a view to have their respective peaceful lives in future.
It has also been stated that interest of the child has also been kept in mind while entering the terms of compromise.

5. I have not found any unlawful term in the settlement arrived at between the parties, therefore,
there is no legal impediment in granting the prayer made in the petition.

6. It is more than settled now that this Court in exercise of jurisdiction under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., in appropriate cases, may quash the criminal proceedings including the FIR notwithstanding involvement of non compoundable offences.

Such jurisdiction, however, is to be ...4...
exercised in the interest of justice or to avoid the abuse of .
process of law.
The husband and wife in the instant case have peacefully parted their ways as both of them were not able to live together despite efforts.
The purpose behind settlement arrived at between the parties was to live their respective lives peacefully.
The step taken by the parties is not only to achieve peace amongst themselves, it also serves prime objective of the civilized society to secure peace for all its subjects.
7. Viewed from another angle, the prolongation of criminal litigation between the parties is likely to prove counter productive.

With the stand now maintained by the parties, there is no likelihood of success of prosecution case and in such view of the matter, to allow the criminal prosecution against the petitioners to be carried forward would only lead to abuse of process of law.
